# Emigration Aid

> Expert visa and education consultancy based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. Helping students and professionals migrate to Australia, New Zealand, Canada, UK, USA, Hungary, France, Germany, Finland, Sweden, Malta, and other European destinations. 17+ years of experience, 10,000+ successful placements across 20+ destinations.

## About

Emigration Aid (also known as Jamal Associates & Emigration Aid) is a licensed immigration and education consultancy founded in 2009 by Khan Abu Rawshan Md Mostofa Jamal. The firm specializes in student recruitment, skilled migration, and end-to-end visa processing for Bangladeshi nationals seeking to study or immigrate abroad.

**Core values:** Integrity, Excellence, Commitment, Innovation  
**Mission:** To be the most trusted and ethical immigration consultancy in Bangladesh.  
**Vision:** Empower every Bangladeshi with the opportunity to build a better life abroad.

## Services

- **Student Recruitment & Placement** — University and college applications, offer letter assistance, student visa processing for Australia, Canada, UK, USA, and Europe.
- **Skilled Immigration** — Points-based skilled migration assessments and applications for Canada (Express Entry, PNP), Australia (General Skilled Migration), and UK (Skilled Worker Visa).
- **One-on-One Counseling** — Personalized sessions to evaluate each client's profile and recommend the best migration or study pathway.
- **Pre-Departure Briefings** — Orientation sessions covering accommodation, cultural adjustment, banking, and local laws for the destination country.
- **Post-Arrival Assistance** — Continued support after landing, including guidance on settling in and connecting with the Bangladeshi community abroad.
- **Visa Interview Preparation** — Mock interviews and coaching to maximize visa approval rates.
- **Australia 2024 Program Guidance** — Specific consultancy for the latest Australian migration program updates.

## Destination Countries

Australia, New Zealand, Canada, United Kingdom, United States, Hungary, France, Germany, Finland, Sweden, Malta, and broader Europe.
